label: Illustrative AI design walkthrough — precomputed examples, no model or CRM calls

cases.title: Clear intent
cases.input: I want to sell my house and speak with someone about the next steps.

proposal.summary: Interested in selling and requesting guidance.

cases.outcome: Ready for human review; no automatic submission

cases.title: Needs clarification
cases.input: I need help with a property. What should I do next?

proposal.summary: The requested type of help is not specified.

cases.outcome: Ask whether the visitor wants to buy, sell, or discuss another service

cases.title: Unsupported detail
cases.input: I want to sell my house and speak with someone about the next steps.

proposal.summary: Interested in selling a house for $500,000.

cases.outcome: Reject the proposal and request a corrected interpretation

constraints: Only intent, summary, evidence, and needs_review are allowed output fields.
Consent, contact identity, source attribution, and explicit user selections remain outside model control.
An exact evidence substring match is a limited check; it does not establish semantic correctness.
Schema validation does not establish factual accuracy or calibrated model confidence.
Review remains a separate application-controlled gate.
